title: Feywild Util
description: Adds random stuff for Shattered Reality. This replaces Shattered Reality FabQuilt.
body: **This is in beta and does not have much content and is likely to have bugs, here be dragons** This is a utility mod for the Shattered Reality server. This mod is slowly readding features from it's previous version, [Shattered Reality FabQuilt](https://modrinth.com/mod/shattered-reality-mod) What it currently adds: - Mirrors - Hand Mirror that will tell you thoughts about yourself - Magic Mirror to go to the mirror dimension - Tall Magic Mirror which acts like the Magic Mirror but in block form
